section38.title: Price Polish in One Sentence
section38.desc: Price Polish helps Shopify merchants safely manage pricing changes through a controlled workflow of: Configure → Preview → Apply → Schedule/Go Live → Track → Revert.

sectionA.title: What is Price Polish?
sectionA.desc: Price Polish is a Shopify pricing management tool designed to help merchants manage product pricing changes in a controlled and traceable workflow.
sectionA.workflow: Core workflow: Configure Pricing Rules → Preview Prices → Review Changes → Apply Pricing → Schedule or Publish → Track History → Revert When Needed.

sectionB.title: Getting Started
sectionB.subtitle: Recommended first steps when you first enter Price Polish.
sectionB.step6: Monitor the resulting campaign in Campaign History.

sectionC.title: Core Workflow
sectionC.subtitle: The main operational sequence from Dashboard to Revert.
sectionC.step1_desc: Review products, preview prices, and access pricing operations.
sectionC.step2_desc: Configure markup, rounding, and charm pricing.
sectionC.step3_desc: Compare existing prices with calculated proposed prices.
sectionC.step4_desc: Commit pricing changes to your Shopify catalog.
sectionC.step5_desc: Plan future pricing operations and temporary windows.

sectionD.title: Pricing Rules
sectionD.subtitle: Defines how Price Polish calculates proposed prices.
sectionD.markup_desc: Percentage increase or decrease applied to the current/base price. A negative markup can be used for a reduction.
sectionD.rounding_desc: Controls the desired decimal ending of the resulting price. For example, a rounding value such as 0.88 can be used to produce prices ending in .88.
sectionD.charm_desc: Psychological price endings such as .99. Disabled or treated as not applicable for currencies where decimal pricing is not applicable.

sectionE.title: Preview & Product Grid
sectionE.subtitle: Review pricing changes before they reach the storefront.
sectionE.preview_desc: Compare the existing price with the calculated proposed price before applying anything. Preview first. Apply second.
sectionE.grid_desc: Product/variant-level visibility including current prices, original prices, calculated target prices, manual overrides, selections, filtering, search, price filters, smart segments, and pagination.
sectionE.override_desc: Manually override a calculated price for an individual item. Manual overrides are preserved separately from auto-calculated prices.

sectionF.title: Apply Pricing
sectionF.subtitle: Commit pricing changes after reviewing the preview.
sectionF.applyAll_desc: Applies pricing changes across the current preview scope.
sectionF.applySelected_desc: Applies pricing only to selected products/variants.
sectionF.undo_desc: Reverses the most recent pricing update from the Dashboard. Original pricing is preserved.

section37.title: Important Operational Expectations
section37.desc: Do not assume that clicking Apply means the entire operation has completed immediately. Check the processing state and Campaign History before assuming the operation is finished.

section10.title: Processing Pricing Updates
section10.subtitle: What to expect while a pricing operation is running.
section10.point1: Do not close the browser while a pricing operation is actively processing.
section10.point2: Batch-oriented processing — large catalogs may take time.

section35.title: Go Live vs Apply
section35.desc: Apply Pricing changes the stored Shopify catalog price. Go Live activates dynamic rules on the storefront only. Stopping Live Pricing does NOT reverse already-applied catalog prices.

sectionG.title: Storefront Control
sectionG.subtitle: Manage whether dynamic pricing rules are active on the storefront.
sectionG.goLive_desc: Activates storefront pricing behavior (not a permanent catalog change).
sectionG.stopLive_desc: Disables live storefront behavior (does NOT undo applied catalog prices).
sectionG.apply_desc: Changes the stored Shopify catalog price.

sectionH.title: Scheduling & Campaigns
sectionH.subtitle: Plan future pricing operations and track campaign status.
sectionH.schedule_desc: Schedule pricing changes for a future time.
sectionH.window_desc: Temporary pricing change that auto-restores when the window ends.
sectionH.conflicts_desc: The system checks for conflicts including publish-time overlaps, all-product schedules, product/variant overlap, and restore-window overlap.
sectionH.history_desc: Operational record showing campaign title, source, product count, created time, status, scheduled activity, revert info, and failed items.
sectionH.detail_desc: Inspect products and execution details for individual campaigns.
sectionH.status_desc: Status values include Draft, Scheduled, Active, Publishing, Published, Reverted, Failed, and Unrecoverable.

sectionI.title: Revert & Safety
sectionI.subtitle: Reverse pricing changes and understand failure states.
sectionI.undo_desc: Reverses the most recent pricing update from the Dashboard.
sectionI.revert_desc: Broader recovery for a full campaign.
sectionI.preview_desc: Review the expected rollback before executing — same philosophy as pricing preview.
sectionI.protection_desc: Pricing history is preserved for all operations.
sectionI.failures_desc: Reverted, Failed, Tracked, and Unrecoverable help you understand if an operation needs further action.

section31.title: Safety Philosophy
section31.subtitle: Price Polish is designed around reducing accidental pricing changes.

sectionJ.title: Quick Reference
sectionJ.subtitle: A quick summary of each feature area.
sectionJ.dashboard_desc: Review products, preview prices, apply pricing, undo recent updates, and control storefront pricing.
sectionJ.rules_desc: Configure markup, rounding, charm pricing, and related pricing behavior.
sectionJ.schedule_desc: Plan future pricing operations and temporary pricing windows.
sectionJ.history_desc: Review what pricing operations happened and their current operational status.
sectionJ.detail_desc: Inspect the details of an individual campaign.
sectionJ.campaignDetail_note: Open a specific campaign from Campaign History to inspect its details.
sectionJ.revert_desc: Review and reverse a previous pricing operation when required.
sectionJ.storefront_desc: Turn dynamic storefront pricing ON or OFF.
sectionJ.billing_desc: Start or restore subscription access and understand which pricing-changing actions require active billing.

sectionK.title: Recommended Workflows
sectionK.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for common pricing operations.
sectionK.schedule_desc: Pricing change at a future planned time.
sectionK.goLive_desc: Dynamic rules active on storefront (not a catalog price change).
